issues.description: Hull class names differ from MOO1 originals. MOO1 uses 4 hull sizes (Small, Medium, Large, Huge), while the wireframe shows 6 named classes (Scout, Fighter, Destroyer, Cruiser, Battlecruiser, Dreadnought). However, this is consistent with ship-classes.md which defines 7 classes for Hamster of Orion as a deliberate design choice.
issues.suggestion: No change needed - this is an intentional deviation from MOO1 documented in ship-classes.md. Consider adding a note in the wireframe referencing this design decision.

issues.description: Hull unlock requirements inconsistent with ship-classes.md. Wireframe states Battlecruiser requires 'Battle Station (Construction 24)' and Dreadnought requires 'Star Fortress (Construction 36)', but ship-classes.md specifies 6,000 RP and 18,000 RP respectively without specific Construction tech levels.
issues.suggestion: Reconcile tech requirements between wireframe and ship-classes.md to ensure consistency.

issues.description: Miniaturization cap stated as 50% in wireframe tooltip but spec should verify this matches other game mechanics documents.
issues.suggestion: Cross-reference with research-formulas.md or components-complete.md to confirm miniaturization cap value.

issues.description: Titan class (7th hull in ship-classes.md) not shown in wireframe hull selection. This may be intentional if Titans are end-game only.
issues.suggestion: Either add Titan as a 7th locked hull class or document that Titans are excluded from standard ship design UI.

summary: Excellent Ship Design UI wireframe specification that meets all requirements. The document provides 12 detailed ASCII wireframes covering: default design list view, hull selection, main ship design editor, weapon selection dropdown, weapon count selection, special systems selection, error state (over budget), scrap confirmation dialog, auto-design options, copy from existing design, design saved confirmation, and miniaturization tooltip. All required elements are present: hull selection (6 classes with stats), component slots (Engine, Weapons, Computer, ECM, Shields, Armor, Specials), weapon assignment system with categories (Beams, Missiles, Torpedoes, Bombs), stats display (space usage, cost, HP, offense/defense/mobility ratings), and save/load functionality. Additional features include keyboard shortcuts (20+ documented), mouse interactions, JSON data schema, state transitions diagram, validation rules, responsive behavior notes, accessibility features (ARIA labels, keyboard navigation), and pet-themed flavor text. The specification is implementation-ready and follows established wireframe format from other UI specs. Minor issues relate to cross-document consistency with ship-classes.md tech requirements rather than MOO1 accuracy, as the project has intentionally expanded hull classes beyond MOO1's original 4 sizes.
